title: Anacreon
premiere: Fontainebleau, Théâtre du château on 23 October 1754

synopsis.text:
The old poet Anacreon pretends he is going to marry his protegée Cloé. She is in love with the young Bathylle, also under Anacreon's protection. Finally, the poet reveals he had planned to marry the two lovers all along.
